remarks: No tracked port is suspended, recovering or under weather watch. None carried an entry last run either.
Dujuan has gone extratropical (LOW) far out in the Pacific at 40N 154E and is dropped from the systems list.

A new tropical depression, TC2632, formed near 14.8N 140.1E. JMA forecasts it to reach typhoon strength in about five days near 21.8N 125.0E, east of Taiwan. The closest forecast point is still 766 km from Xiamen, outside the 600 km threat radius, so no threat is recorded yet. Watch it on the next runs: if the track bends toward the Taiwan Strait or East China Sea, Xiamen, Shenzhen and Shanghai/Ningbo come into range right around Golden Week.

The big queues at Shanghai (K+N 4.72 days average wait) and Ningbo (2.51 days) are congestion and pre-Golden Week volume, not weather. They are kept out of the port list so the site's idle-berth flag stays live.
Busan closes for Chuseok on 25 Sep. That is a scheduled holiday, not a weather event, so no entry is written.
